description: Elections Commission - Y. M. S. Bandara of the Galgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - M. A. S. Kumari of the Kuliyapitiya Urban Council has vacated her member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - P. W. G. J. N. Fernando, of the Kuliyapitiya Urban Council has vacated member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A (1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that members of local government bodies (Galgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha and Kuliyapitiya Urban Council) have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content specifically deals with electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local authorities, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including declarations about elected members.
